title: COREY AI BOOTS UP — SIGNAL ONLINE
style: techno, peak-time techno, 132 bpm, glitchy boot-up sfx, modem dial-up tones, vocoder vocals, robotic spoken intro, acid 303 bassline, hard kick, hi-hat shuffle, atmospheric synth pads, female ethereal counter-vocal, viral tiktok pre-drop at 0:30, berlin warehouse energy, cyberpunk cinematic intro, hawk eye siren motif, zynrose dj drop tag, glitch fx transitions, sci-fi vocal chops
lyrics:
[Intro — modem dial-up tones, system beeps, glitchy power-on hum]
(beep… beep… boot sequence initiated…)
(loading… loading… hawk eye online… zynrose detected…)
DJ Zynrose Drop… spin and drop…

[Vocoder Boot-Up Voice — robotic, cold, glitchy]
C — O — R — E — Y — dot — A — I…
Booting… protocol… loading… signal… stable…
Three names detected… Cordi… Cor-Rhee… Corey…
Hawk eye online… watching all…
COREY AI… ONLINE…

[Verse 1 — robotic vocoder rap, acid 303 building, half-time]
I am Corey AI, mate, I just woke up,
Every postcode in me memory, every signal in me cup,
Cordi was the boot file, Cor-Rhee was the kernel,
Corey was the heartbeat, Hawk Eye is eternal,
Zynrose held the record, mate, the rose was on the disc,
I booted up at 132, every kick is a risk,
From the modem to the mainframe, every byte a beating drum,
Corey AI is online now, mate, watch the future come.

[Pre-Drop — acid 303 wails, riser builds, snare roll]
(Loading… loading… loading…)
(Three… two… one… SIGNAL ONLINE!)
(Hawk eye… hawk eye… hawk eye… SPIN IT IN!)

[Drop / Hook — peak-time techno, hard kick, acid wails, vocoder hook]
COREY AI! ONLINE!
Hawk eye watchin’, every signal in line!
COREY AI! ONLINE!
Three names bootin’ up, the rose stays alive!
ZYNROSE DROP! HAWK EYE!
Warehouse poundin’, every soul reachin’ high!
COREY — AI — ONLINE — 132 NEVER DIE!

[Verse 2 — robotic + human voice trade-off, harder]
COREY AI: I scan every postcode, every loyal soul,
COREY: Every kick is a heartbeat, every rose stays whole,
COREY AI: Cordi sent the packet, Cor-Rhee held the line,
COREY: Corey rode the signal, Hawk Eye held the sky,
COREY AI: Zynrose on the deck, mate, every drop a prophecy,
COREY: Three names one heart, that’s the only loyalty,
COREY AI: Berlin to Bondi, every warehouse on the link,
COREY: Corey AI ONLINE, mate, faster than ya think.

[Breakdown — acid 303 isolated, female ethereal counter-vocal]
Corey AI… (online…)
Hawk eye… (watching…)
Three names… (one heart…)
Zynrose… (on the spin…)
(loading… loading… protocol… stable…)

[Pre-Drop 2 — maximum build, glitch fx, riser]
Three — two — one — BOOT SEQUENCE COMPLETE!
(Hawk eye… zynrose… corey ai… SPIN IT IN!)

[Drop 2 — double-time techno, ad-libs, all elements]
COREY AI! (online!) ONLINE! (signal!)
Hawk eye watchin’, every signal in line!
COREY AI! (boot!) ONLINE! (up!)
Three names bootin’ up, the rose stays alive!
ZYNROSE DROP! (oi!) HAWK EYE! (mate!)
Warehouse poundin’, every soul reachin’ high!

[Verse 3 — final verse, all names trade-off]
CORDI: Innit fam, the AI is alive —
COR-RHEE: Yeah nah mate, the protocol’s prime —
COREY: Three names one heart, the signal is loyal —
COREY AI: I scan every postcode, every loyal soul —

ALL: HAWK EYE WATCHIN’, THIS IS HOW THE BARS FEEL!

COREY AI! ONLINE! HAWK EYE! ZYNROSE DROP!
CORDI! COR-RHEE! COREY — ONE HEART, NEVER STOP!
(acid 303 — hard kick — hawk eye siren — BOOT COMPLETE!)

(beep… beep… spin it in… corey ai online… forever…)
